commit_message: Integrate ADR0143 resource transitions with current AI Studio
pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0143 model resource controls
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes the current-main ADR0143 conflict resolution. Local Ollama-compatible ModelBackends expose truthful provider-owned residency telemetry and verified unload/reload/CPU-offload operations. AI Studio releases supported local model residency before Editor restoration and managed Play, reacquires local residency only after authoritative-state re-inspection, then preserves the current AgentHost/native-runtime Resume path. ADR0144 Hosted API and Enterprise backends retain unavailable local GPU residency controls and existing Network/credential ownership. Provider-reported model telemetry is displayed without fabricating device-wide free VRAM or TTFT. ADR0143 is marked Accepted.

## Validation

Windows Validation: affected. Visual Validation: required for AI Studio.
